description: Build a responsive profile or portfolio page that works well on desktop and mobile screens.
requirements: Repository should contain a runnable frontend project or static web page
Page should include profile information, skills and at least two project or experience sections
Layout should be responsive for mobile and desktop viewports
CSS should be organized in a separate stylesheet, component style file or framework configuration
README.md should explain how to run or open the page locally
title: Build Responsive Profile Page
